test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I prefer to listen to relaxing and ______ music when meditating.
solution:
The correct answer is **Soothing.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **“Soothing**” refers to **something pleasant and nice**.
 
• Therefore, the complete sentence is**, “****I prefer to listen to relaxing and soothing music when meditating.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **“Abrading”** means to rub away something or to scrape something.
 
• **“Fret”** has a similar meaning to that of abraiding.
 
• **“Tormenting”** refers to something which is not very pleasant.
